Maya (Product): New ask from FinReg: console needs a compact "Audit Evidence" flow — show per-tenant costs by route and let auditors download a redacted trace sample. We need to scope an MVP for Q2.
Tara (Eng): Per-token attribution is hard. For MVP do estimated cost per request (token estimate * cost_per_token) and deterministic sampling for traces.
Ibrahim (SRE): Ops concern: trace retention and export egress drive cost. Proposal: hot index 7d, archive 90d, default sampling 1% with tenant override.
Nadia (Security): Redaction must be verifiable. We should store redaction events (counts + pattern ids) and produce a redaction report bundled with exports. No raw PII stored.
Jorge (Customer Success): FinReg prefers CSV or parquet. They also want a signed export and a simple UI: tenant selector, date range, export button. Latency overhead is a question.
Sam (Solutions): UI idea: single tile "Audit Cost & Traces" -> modal with cost sparkline, sampled traces table, export action. Keep filtering minimal for MVP.
Maya (Product): Proposed MVP cuts: 1) aggregated per-route cost (7d view), 2) deterministic sampled traces with pre-storage redaction, 3) console tile + CSV/Parquet export, 4) tenant opt-in pilot (1 customer). Launch criteria: pilot ingestion, redaction report, perf check.
Tara (Eng): Implementation sketch: ingress hook tags tenant+route, estimate token_count, hash-based stable sampling, stream to async pipeline -> redaction service -> short-term store -> export job. Need small schema change + redaction microservice. Pseudoconfig: 
```
audit:
  sampling_rate: 0.01
  hot_days: 7
  archive_days: 90
  redaction_patterns: [email, ssn, cc]
```
Ibrahim (SRE): Make pipeline async so main request path unaffected. Add backpressure metrics and drop strategy when consumer lag >30s. SLO: pipeline must not add >5ms when async.
Nadia (Security): Exports signed with KMS-backed key; include redaction report (pattern list + counts). Rotate keys quarterly.
Jorge (Customer Success): I'll get FinReg's export schema and confirm sampling tolerance.
Maya (Product): Action items: Jorge get schema (due Thu), Tara draft design doc (due Tue), Sam provide mock (due Wed), Nadia provide security checklist (due Wed), Ibrahim propose retention/cost estimate (due Wed). I'll schedule a 30m sync.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/audit-evidence-flow :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): If all green, aim Q2 pilot. Success metrics: exported traces + redaction report, console tile <200ms render, no significant latency regression.
Tara (Eng): Will include risk section: redaction false negatives, storage blowout, sampling edge cases. Plan rollback for pilot.
Ibrahim (SRE): Also will add cost forecast to infra checklist.
Maya (Product): Thanks team. Closing until design PR.
